Trace, implement and test: leetcode7 reverse integer

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include <algorithm>
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int reverse(int x) {
        int sign = 1;
        if(x < 0)
            sign = -1;        
        string str = to_string(x);
        std::reverse(str.begin(), str.end());  /* Leetcode的C++编译环境中出现了多个reverse函数，无法准确匹配到，所以需要加上std命名空间。 */
        long res = stol(str); /* 如果reverse后得到的字符串末尾有-，会在这里自动删除 */
        if(res < INT_MIN || res > INT_MAX)
            return 0;
        
        return sign*res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    int n = -666666666;
    auto res = sol.reverse(n);
    cout << res << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
